contexts.text: Take to you the fulness of your fists () = power given so far as it could be received. Fists, or palms, = power.

(If) a man smite his companion with a stone or with his fist () = the weakening of one (truth) from some scientific or some general truth... A fist = general truth; for by the hand is signified the power which is of truth; hence a fist = full power from general truth: that truth is called general which is everywhere received... Hence to smite with a fist = with full force and power; in the spiritual sense, by truths from good, and in the opposite sense, by falsities from evil: as in , where to smite with the fist of wickedness = with full force by falsities from evil.
As they are not permitted to inflict any bodily injury, they threaten with mouth and fists.
